newsitem.title: FRANCE: Russia's General Lebed arrives for French visit.
newsitem.headline: Russia's General Lebed arrives for French visit.

text.p: Former Russian security chief General Alexander Lebed arrived in France on Sunday for a five-day private visit during which he will meet political leaders but not government ministers.
Lebed's Sunday schedule included a visit to Napoleon's tomb and the French army museum followed by a television interview.
During his visit, he will meet the presidents of the National Assembly and the Senate as well as Socialist opposition leader Lionel Jospin.

Lebed, who was sacked by President Boris Yeltsin last October, will also meet several prominent members of the ruling Rally for the Republic (RPR) Gaullist party, including Senator Philippe de Gaulle, son of former president Charles de Gaulle .
